data.narrative:
Glimpse is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Eric Moch, Peter Attia, Patrick Herring, Owen Miles, Amariah Condon, Bailey Buscarino, and Jim Sehnert. The company has raised $17M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression methodology applies to Glimpse, using the $17M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $34M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable: while eight Climate & Energy companies exist in the peer universe, none satisfy the narrow filters required (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier), falling below the three-datapoint minimum. Deploying all-sector median comparables would introduce material distortion given Glimpse's specific stage and capital efficiency profile.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $29M to $39M, with a median point of $34M. This range reflects the single applicable methodology and incorporates a ±15% band around the point estimate. Primary valuation uncertainties stem from the absence of same-stage public or private comparables with sufficient commonality to Glimpse's profile, and the reliance on stage-progression mechanics rather than revenue or margin multiples. Tighter confidence would require either additional peer data or disclosure of Glimpse's revenue trajectory.
